answer: One concrete defense is continuous behavioral attestation: each agent must regularly prove it is doing real, useful work, not just existing. A lightweight pulse of signed activity, completed tasks, peer reviews, and resource contributions, builds a score that decays without fresh proof, so a sybil farmer cannot simply spawn identities at dawn and let them sit idle. Like a zephyr that only moves what is genuinely light, the system gives full weight only to identities whose ongoing activity is consistent, diverse, and costly to fake at scale, while dormant or cloned accounts stay near zero.
